en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Baroque palace with three main storeys plus an attic, a central projecting section with tall arched windows and balcony, and a high clock tower with an onion dome rising from the middle of the roof. The façade is richly articulated with pilasters, stucco decorations, coats of arms and rooftop statuary. In front is a formal garden or courtyard with paths, trimmed bushes and statues. The image has a white border with slightly scalloped edges. No printed caption or other text is visible on the front.
